BiblicalUsage: Gemalli is a person named once in Scripture, in Numbers. The full story lives on the Gemalli profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps Gemalli in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
